annotations.description: Annotations is an unstructured key value map stored with a resource that may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata.

aws.description: AWS authentication configuration for the home identity. Leave every field unset when the pod authenticates through IRSA or an instance profile.

aws_access_key_id.description: AWS access key ID for the chart-managed credentials Secret. Do not set when using aws.secret.name or IRSA.

aws_secret_access_key.description: AWS secret access key for the chart-managed credentials Secret. Do not set when using aws.secret.name or IRSA.

secret.description: Reference to a pre-created Kubernetes Secret that holds the AWS credentials.

name.description: Name of the pre-created Kubernetes Secret. The Secret must contain the keys access_key and secret_key, and security_token when includesSessionToken is true. When set, the chart does not create its own Secret.

includesSessionToken.description: Whether the pre-created Secret also contains a security_token key with an STS session token.

command.description: Override the default container command used to start yace-exporter. When set, it fully replaces the entrypoint, so -listen-address and -config.file must be passed explicitly.

config.description: YACE v1alpha1 configuration rendered into the ConfigMap mounted by the container.

configFile.description: Path to the configuration file mounted from the ConfigMap and passed to -config.file.

containerPort.description: Port exposed by the yace-exporter container. Must match the port in listenAddress.

extraArgs.description: Additional command-line flags appended to the default arguments of yace-exporter, for example -scraping-interval or -labels-snake-case.

image.description:
A docker image for yace-exporter in the format <repository>:<tag>.
Default: docker.io/prometheuscommunity/yet-another-cloudwatch-exporter:v0.67.0

imagePullPolicy.description: Image pull policy for the yace-exporter container.

labels.description: Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) objects.

listenAddress.description: Network address the yace-exporter HTTP server binds to. The upstream default 127.0.0.1:5000 is not reachable from outside the container.

name.description: Name used for the yace-exporter deployment and related resources.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for scheduling yace-exporter pods.

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClassName assigned to the yace-exporter pods to prevent them from evicting.

rbac.description: RBAC configuration for yace-exporter. The exporter does not call the Kubernetes API, so both flags default to false.

createClusterRole.description: Allow creating ClusterRole. If false, ClusterRole must be created manually.

createClusterRoleBinding.description: Allow creating ClusterRoleBinding. If false, ClusterRoleBinding must be created manually.

replicas.description: Number of yace-exporter replicas to deploy.

resources.description: Compute resource requests and limits for yace-exporter pods.

limits.description: Maximum compute resources allocated to yace-exporter pods.

cpu.description: CPU limit for yace-exporter pods, e.g. '500m' for 0.5 CPU cores.

memory.description: Memory limit for yace-exporter pods, e.g. '256Mi' for 256 MiB of memory.

requests.description: Minimum compute resources required for yace-exporter pods.

cpu.description: CPU request for yace-exporter pods, e.g. '250m' for 0.25 CPU cores.

memory.description: Memory request for yace-exporter pods, e.g. '128Mi' for 128 MiB of memory.

securityContext.description: SecurityContext holds pod-level security attributes. The parameters are required if a Pod Security Policy is enabled for Kubernetes cluster and required if a Security Context Constraints is enabled for Openshift cluster.

runAsUser.description:
The UID to run the entrypoint of the container process.
Defaults to user specified in image metadata if unspecified.

fsGroup.description: A special supplemental group that applies to all containers in a pod. Required to read the EKS IAM token when using IRSA.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the yace-exporter Service.

labels.description: Labels to add to the yace-exporter Service.

port.description: Port exposed by the yace-exporter Service.

portName.description: Name of the service port exposed by yace-exporter.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the yace-exporter ServiceAccount. Use them to attach an IAM Role for Service Accounts (IRSA).

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Whether the service account token should be automatically mounted into the pod.

install.description: Whether a ServiceAccount should be created.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount to use.

install.description: Whether to create a ServiceMonitor for yace-exporter.

interval.description: Set how frequently Prometheus should scrape.

metricRelabelings.description: MetricRelabelConfigs to apply to samples before ingestion.

items.description: A Prometheus MetricRelabelConfig. See https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/configuration/#metric_relabel_configs for details.

relabelings.description: RelabelConfigs to apply to the scrape request before scraping.

items.description: A Prometheus RelabelConfig. See https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/configuration/#relabel_config for details.

telemetryPath.description: Telemetry path used by the ServiceMonitor to scrape metrics.

tolerations.description: Tolerations allow the pod to schedule onto nodes with matching taints.
